name: skill-sync
summary: Keeps every skill GJ builds in sync across Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity through the allsxxing/skills GitHub registry. Use when a skill is created or updated in any app, when GJ pastes a skill from Gemini, Grok, or Perplexity, when he asks which platform copies are outdated, or wants a skill ported to another platform. Triggers on /skillsync, /skills, sync skill, save skill to repo, push skill, port skill to Gemini/Grok/Perplexity, skill status, what's outdated, or the end of any skill-creator session.

changelog.note: Runs through the allsxxing/skills MCP; versioning moved server-side
